note: Every picture and every sound published on the Tino Tuala Travels mock-up. Photographs, artworks, reward pictures and animal recordings come from Wikimedia Commons under a licence that permits reuse; the two photographs of Tino were supplied by him. The animal recordings are trimmed and re-encoded; the echoes you hear are added live in the browser and are not part of the original files.
